summary_md: **Nithin ([@nithin_r_g](https://x.com/nithin_r_g/status/2115416753421668733))** reports **Memory Tax**: 11 agent memory systems tested against plain retrieval lost 90 of 99 matchups and cost more, so verify a memory layer beats plain search before building one.

referenced_urls.title: Memory Tax: Dissecting the Net Value of Agent Memory

relevance: A strong empirical check on whether agent memory layers pay off.

media.description: Bubble chart 'Acc-Cost Pareto · LongMemEval-s · Qwen3.6-27B': accuracy vs token cost per corpus (log scale). Plain RAG variants sit top-left (high accuracy, ~10K tokens) while memory systems such as MemOS, HippoRAG2, A-Mem, Mem-T, MemoryOS, MAGMA and OpenViking cost far more for similar or lower accuracy.
